topic_title: Speed Related to Stopping & Roadway Conditions
prompt: In an emergency stop with Antilock Braking Systems (ABS), what is the correct driver pedal technique?

options.text: Stomp firmly on brake pedal, stay hard on pedal, and steer around hazard
Pump the brake pedal vigorously up and down to prevent brake lockup
Shift transmission quickly into neutral and pull the emergency parking brake
Tap the pedal gently three times and release steering wheel control completely
